note: Findings of security/check_gitignore.py that were triaged as NOT secrets. Each entry is the SHA-256 of the matched text, never the text. Adding an entry needs a reviewer, like a code change.
triage_2026-10-07: The scanner flagged hand-written fake tokens in Week 9 test and evidence code. Decoding the JWTs gives header {"alg":"HS256"}, payload {"sub":"x"} or {"sub":"chw_amina"}, and the literal signature text 'signature' / 'signature-sample': they were never signed by any key and are rejected by afyaplus/auth.py. The sk-proj- value is the alphabet, not an OpenAI key. Nothing to rotate. From the next commit on, tests and the evidence script build these fakes at runtime, so no new token-shaped literal enters git.
